name: Viper-M3-3.2
source:
A love triangle develops between Kenji and the two women he's grown to love. Will he choose his childhood friend and cosplay-fanatic, Kaoru, or the beautiful and charming, Rika? And whomever he chooses, will the other be jealous?

[From [url=http://www.sognadigitalmuseum.com/series/m3.html]Sogna Digital Museum[/url]]
translation:
健二和他逐渐爱上的两名女性之间展开了一段三角恋。他会选择青梅竹马兼cosplay狂热者的薰，还是美丽动人的理华？而无论他选择谁，另一方是否会嫉妒？

[引自[url=http://www.sognadigitalmuseum.com/series/m3.html]Sogna Digital Museum[/url]]
